title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 21: the famine and the Gibeonites, Rizpah's vigil, Saul's bones, and the giants of Gath.

questions.text: Why was there a famine in the days of David, according to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he put the Gibeonites to death."

answers.text: Because David had counted the people
Because the ark was not in Jerusalem
Because Saul had put the Gibeonites to death

questions.text: Of which people were the Gibeonites a remnant?
questions.explanation: The Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites.

questions.text: How many of Saul's sons did the Gibeonites ask to be delivered to them?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let seven men of his sons be delivered to us."

questions.text: Whom did the king spare because of Yahweh's oath between David and Jonathan?
questions.explanation: The king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of Yahweh's oath between David and Jonathan.

questions.text: When were the seven put to death?
questions.explanation: They were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, at the beginning of barley harvest.

answers.text: At the end of wheat harvest
At the beginning of barley harvest

questions.text: What did Rizpah spread for herself on the rock?
questions.explanation: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock.

questions.text: Where did they bury the bones of Saul and Jonathan?
questions.explanation: They buried them in the country of Benjamin in Zela, in the tomb of Kish his father.

answers.text: In Zela, in the tomb of Kish
In Gibeah of Saul, by his house

questions.text: Why did David's men say he should not go out to battle any more?
questions.explanation: They said, "Don't go out with us to battle any more, so that you don't quench the lamp of Israel."

answers.text: Because he was too old to lead
So that he would not quench the lamp of Israel

questions.text: Whom did Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite kill?
questions.explanation: Elhanan the son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite's brother.

answers.text: Saph, a son of the giant

questions.text: Who killed the man of great stature at Gath who had six fingers on every hand?
questions.explanation: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimei, David's brother, killed him.
